Welcome to Longest Tower Race!

🔥Update:
- New blocks animations
- Added 10 new block skins
- Coins around the map
- Revamped block skins equip
- Earn +5 coins per correct answer

Type the longest top answer to each randomly generated questions and save yourself from the inevitable rising water. Think of the longest possible answer to build your blocks and be the last man standing to beat your opponents and earn wins to climb your rank in the leaderboard.

🏆 Collect wins and blocks to unlock colorful block skin.

👍 Like the game and ✅ Join the group to unlock the SPECIAL REWARDS 🎁
🔥 Premium Benefits: Free Rainbow Halo
